text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer identifies what is in a picture, such as a cat or a car. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects in an image. Computer vision has many useful applications in our daily lives. For example, it is used in security cameras, medical imaging, and shopping apps. It also plays a big role in self-driving cars, which use cameras and sensors to detect roads, people, and other vehicles. Thanks to computer vision, machines can "see" and make smart decisions.
